topic: Issuing full and partial refunds from an internal admin page through a card payment provider.
checker_notes: Minor: seeded_presentation writes 'Available balance = captured_amount minus pending + succeeded refunds', which can be read as (captured − pending) + succeeded. Reword it to 'captured_amount minus (pending + succeeded)' so q1 is still recoverable without guessing the intended grouping.

Minor: the q5 key says the order status 'is recomputed when a refund becomes succeeded', but the brief only says the status is based on succeeded refunds. Graders should also accept a design that computes it when the order is read, or the key should say 'changes only once a refund has succeeded'.
